courses.title: UI/UX Design Specialization by California Institute of the Arts

data_json.name: Aaryaman Thapa

feedback.detail: Summary is present, but it leans heavily into digital marketing rather than UI/UX design. Tailor your objective to highlight design thinking and user-centric problem solving.
Education section is properly detailed with degree and institution name.
Freelance website design and graphic design roles are listed. Ensure you emphasize design outcomes and methodologies used.
No formal UI/UX internships listed. Try to secure a design internship or contribute to open-source projects.
Technical skills section is included, but it lacks core UI/UX tools like Figma, wireframing, and user testing methodologies.
Hobbies section is missing, though optional, it can add personality to your resume.
No specific professional interests are listed.
Good inclusion of sports achievements and academic tournament placements.
Certifications are included, though they lean more towards networking and web development. Add UI/UX specific certifications.
Projects like 'Mero Match' are present. Ensure you describe your specific contribution to the UI/UX design process.

recommended_courses.title: UI/UX Design Specialization by California Institute of the Arts

data_json.experience_relevance: Your experience leans heavily toward digital marketing and general website design/graphics. To target UI/UX design, you need to highlight user-centered design processes, wireframing, and interactive prototyping.
data_json.education_relevance: Your Bachelor of Business Information Systems (BBIS) provides a great hybrid foundation of business logic and basic technical understanding, which is highly beneficial for understanding product strategy in UX.
strengths: Strong educational background in Business Information Systems
Multidisciplinary exposure including marketing, graphic design, and basic web development
Extensive volunteering and extracurricular involvement showing leadership and teamwork
Clear project experience with 'Mero Match' web platform
weaknesses: Lack of explicit mention of core UI/UX tools (Figma, Sketch, Adobe XD)
Resume currently reads more like a digital marketing profile than a UI/UX design profile
Missing metrics and quantitative impact in project descriptions
Absence of user research and usability testing mentions
industry_specific_recommendations: Pivot your summary and project bullet points to focus on user experience, wireframes, and design systems rather than marketing campaigns.
Include a link to your interactive portfolio (Behance, Dribbble, or personal website).
Highlight your problem-solving process using the Double Diamond or Design Thinking methodology.
suggested_projects: Redesign an existing popular local e-commerce or utility app focusing on improving user flow and accessibility.
Develop a comprehensive Design System in Figma for a hypothetical SaaS product.
Conduct a full UX case study including user interviews, persona creation, wireframing, and high-fidelity prototyping.
data_json.interview_readiness: Moderate. While you have great foundational technical and business exposure, you will need to prepare a strong design portfolio and be ready to explain your design decisions using user-centric metrics during interviews.
career_growth_suggestions: Build a robust portfolio showcasing at least 3 detailed UX case studies.
Network with senior product designers on LinkedIn and seek mentorship.
Participate in design hackathons to gain rapid problem-solving experience.
Transition from a generalist digital background into a dedicated Junior UI/UX Designer role.
